label: Draft NIH Biosafety Policy (NOT-OD-26-112)
statusNote: A draft: comments closed October 19, 2026. It would replace the NIH Guidelines and extend oversight to all biohazards. Re-check its status at each release.

triggers.label: Reportable incident known
triggers.hint: The institution becomes aware of a reportable incident, such as a potential laboratory-acquired infection.

clocks.label: Notice to NIH (proposed)
clocks.rule: Proposed: notice within 24 hours of awareness. Lower-risk incidents would go to the IBC.

appliesTo.note: A tabletop on what procedures a draft policy would need.
